title: sabina horizontalis
intro: Sabina horizontalis, commonly known as Juniperus horizontalis, is a small to medium-sized evergreen coniferous shrub native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs due to its expectorant properties. The health benefits of Sabina horizontalis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe and protect the body from oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Sabina horizontalis include essential oils, terpenes, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and promoting relaxation.
